_comment: Hand-maintained Sleeper player id -> CFBD athlete id, for players src/cfb/link.py can't
resolve on its own. Set the value to null to record 'confirmed no CFBD coverage' (D2/D3,
NAIA, international) — that suppresses the player from the unresolved report without
inventing a link. Find athlete ids at https://api.collegefootballdata.com/roster or in
the cached cfb_rosters_<season>.parquet files under cache/cfb/raw/.
